boundary: slots the interpreter vacates and reuses without releasing them (GC pages, hash entry arrays)
title: Planned: temporal defects in client code of mruby's own slot allocators
live_in_pin_note: No cases yet. Seven candidates are measured live at the pin and listed in CANDIDATES.md, three of them invisible to ASan; each is reproduced by the upstream test that shipped with its own fix, and four are attributed by a control that carries that fix.
note: CANDIDATES.md replaces this corpus's earlier premise. The xlang mruby rows cannot fill it: rows.tsv's own alloc_route column puts every one of them on a real free, realloc or neither, so sublet answers them at the malloc layer and the sublet-gc arm (patches/4.0.0-rc2/0008) stays unexercised. The three ASan-silent candidates are the ones that reach this boundary; probe/survey.sh rebuilds the measurement.
